caption: The drawing depicts three wooden objects displayed vertically side by side on a light, beige background. The two objects on the left have a similar shape, each consisting of a cylindrical form that forks into two prongs at the bottom; both have rounded tops colored in a reddish-brown hue, with wood grain texture visible throughout. The object on the far left has a slightly narrower shape, while the middle object appears wider and with a deeper brown shade at the top. The object on the right is a single, solid cylindrical piece with a rounded end at the top, resembling a peg, and is rendered in a lighter, uniform brown color with visible wood grain details; it does not fork at the bottom. All three objects are shaded and textured to suggest a three-dimensional wooden appearance.
title: Clothes Pins
